newsitem.title: USA: Morgan's Foods Q4 shr loss widens.
newsitem.headline: Morgan's Foods Q4 shr loss widens.

text.p: (All data above 000s except per share numbers)
NOTE: Full company name Morgan's Foods Inc.
Q4 1997's decrease in revenue was almost entirely attributable to the inclusion of an additional week in the fiscal 1996 quarter, company said.
Fiscal 1997 both periods includes a non-recurring charge of $2,939,000 pretax for asset impairments.
Fiscal 1997 net includes losses on disposal of unprofitable Kentucky Fried Chicken restaurants of $153,000 in Q4 and $248,000 in year.
Fiscal 1996 year net income included a non-recurring gain on sale of 24 KFC restaurants of $1,681,000. Excluding this gain there was a net loss of $555,000 in fiscal 1996.
Q4 1997 net loss before the non-recurring charges would have been $845,000 or $0.05 per share.
Loss for fiscal 1997 year before non-recurring charges was $868,000.
